records.title: If np is fixed then np equals conp
records.description:
NOT A NOVELTY CLAIM. This is a FORMALISATION of a known result: machine-checked in Lean 4, axiom-free, dated and citable. The prior art is cited in the references. No discovery is claimed.

THE HONEST IMPLICATION — a real one, not a projection of its own hypothesis. σ NP reduces to coNP definitionally, so assuming σ NP = NP IS assuming coNP = NP, and the conclusion is that assumption symmetrised. Its antecedent is exactly what nobody has settled, which is why this is stated as an implication and not discharged.  (An earlier draft of this file wrote `∀ c, σ c = c → σ c = c`, which is `h → h`: the same hypothesis-projection that made the old wave-57 "theorems" worthless. Removed.)

records.title: Star is an endomorphism only in the middle
records.description:
NOT A NOVELTY CLAIM. This is a FORMALISATION of a known result: machine-checked in Lean 4, axiom-free, dated and citable. The prior art is cited in the references. No discovery is claimed.

★ sends Λ^k to Λ^(n−k), so it is an ENDOMORPHISM exactly when k = n − k. At n = 4 that holds for k = 2 and fails for k = 1, which is why the self-dual split is a statement about 2-forms in four dimensions and not about forms in general.
